car.name: Hemlock RT 2005
car.description: Original logo-free 2994 salvaged long-roof V8 wagon. US2005 Dodge Magnum RT RWD5AT LHD standard18in wheels, no optional self-leveling suspension/tow package; not AWD/SRT8. Published anchors with explicitly estimated simulation tuning.

fields: Seven-page PDF downloaded. Actual pages3/4/6 rendered and personally viewed for engine,transmission,dimensions,mass,tires; whole technical text read.

estimates: OEM PDF pairs390lbft with525Nm, which are not exact equivalents; preserve primary imperial390 and use528.769Nm converted, disclose discrepancy.
OEM dimensions rounded pairs differ slightly: metric1481mmheight vs58.4in implies1483.36mm; use printedmetric consistently, not silent averaging.
Cylinder deactivation and adaptive converter strategy are not demonstrated supported by game; standard combustion torque and generic automatic are explicit approximations, not hybrid.
Do not use4AT, AWDfinal3.07 or AWDmass1992kg. Differential locking is not established by source; do not invent LSD.
Full torque curve between/away from published anchors
Idle speed, shift timings, launch and clutch or converter parameters
CG height, inertia, tire grip/pressure, dynamic brake bias, damping and springs unless specified
Differential details and control behavior unless verified; do not claim electronic stability/ABS/cylinder-deactivation fidelity
Conservative open differential is a simulation abstraction, not OEM differential fidelity. No special ABS, cylinder deactivation, stability-control or AutoStick behavior claimed.

750idle, 5600redline/5800cut (Hemlock5800max and Hawthorn6500redline sourced; other limits estimated), torque curve outside published anchors, shift/launch controls, 20mpg, displayed acceleration/top speed, generic suspension/brakes/grip/CG/colliders are simulation estimates. Hawthorn steering16, Cd.35 and clearance.135 are estimates.
Nominal tire radius is unloaded geometric radius, not measured rolling radius. Paired OEM imperial/metric ratings disagree; primary lb-ft is preserved. No driver mass adjustment.
Original art; fixed-rear; existing tire smoke/spray only; shared steering wheel with wheel-opening interior gauges.
